messages:
Iris: Quick sync — I opened a PR to add a compact APAC note and tiny SDK examples for the Region Availability page: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/962. Need: legal-approved residency blurb + confirm canonical region id for examples.

Tom (Docs): I'll take wording pass. Can we keep the blurb <= 110 chars for translations? Also prefer header-based region override examples (X-Redwood-Region) not query strings.

Eli (Platform): Confirm header is canonical. Use region id `apac-sg-1` in public examples. Important: private/on-prem installs have custom base URL so don't show those addresses in the public doc. Example curl we recommend: 

```bash
curl -H "X-Redwood-Region: apac-sg-1" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate
```

Grace (Legal): For logs/residency language please use: "Request logs are retained for up to 30 days for operational troubleshooting and abuse prevention." Do not use phrasing that implies in-country residency guarantees. Add pointer to contact Support for contractual residency.

Mara-L10N: I'll prep i18n keys once wording is final. Reminder: keep strings short to avoid extra translation cost. Country names should use our canonical `display_name`.

Iris: Updated PR with Grace's exact sentence and trimmed blurb to 98 chars. Added Python/JS SDK one-liners showing region override: 

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
client.set_region("apac-sg-1")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this")
```

```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
client.setRegion('apac-sg-1');
await client.generate('Summarize this');
```

Tom (Docs): LGTM for tone. I'll also replace two legacy snippets in `/docs/samples/region-examples.md` that still use `region=` query param in a follow-up (file issue).

docs-bot: PR #962 updated by Iris: 'APAC region blurb + SDK one-liners' 1 file changed. CI: docs-link-check, i18n-lint pending.

Eli (Platform): One small nit: use header key casing exactly `X-Redwood-Region` in examples.

Iris: Fixed header casing in curl. Thanks all — will merge once i18n-lint is green and Mara confirms keys. :thumbsup:
